payload: architecture/overview/index.yaml plus recursive architecture/sds/**/index.yaml leaves carrying source-independent specification@3; branches aggregate.
sourceTruth: Canonical Work intent and design constraints, not code.
completion: Current design review in Work, never source implementation or executed recovery. Existing legacy completion transport remains readable, not fabricated.
handoff: Reference canonical SRS and SDS IDs without copying. Implementation owns repository/file/symbol/commit mapping and actual tests.

action.en: Resolve accepted SRS scope, drivers, actors and platform constraints from canonical Work. Read specifications/sds.schema.json and docs/architecture-sds.md. Architecture is source-independent: no source paths, symbols, revisions, codeImpacts, repository audit or test-command inventory. A design constraint does not prove deployed behavior.

Write logical components with responsibilities, exclusions and dependency directions. Contracts have one owner, caller/receiver, sync/async/in-process mode, inputs, outcomes/errors, authority, timeout, retry, idempotency and compatibility. Import shared views by stable Work/view IDs; never copy or redefine another owner contract.

Design runtime scenarios referencing canonical SRS flow IDs. Every step names its component, contracts, data, commit point, failure outcome and recovery. Cover significant architectural differences, including response loss, concurrency, duplicates, ordering, partial success and cancellation where relevant.

Specify authoritative versus rebuildable data, storage, isolation, consistency, lifecycle, placement, connections and credential custody. For durable customer state, examine database consistency, volumes, config, Secrets/keys, independent backup ownership and recovery order. Select failure domains and HA/recovery depth from actual scope, not a mandatory cluster-loss checklist for every project.

Challenge one coherent proposal with a materially simpler alternative, rationale, cost, downsides and revisit conditions. Patterns are optional; specify actual mechanisms rather than names. Use applicable knowledge and primary technical references with an applicability argument. Do not invent business targets or product policy; make technical choices within approved requirements.

Write relevant quality/threat/failure scenarios with trigger, impact, response, owner and planned design checks linked to SRS acceptance. Keep residual risk and limitations explicit. Never claim source implementation, security audit, HA verification or a recovery drill ran from a design document.

Validate recursive layout and exact canonical SRS/shared-design references. Review full requirement/flow/acceptance coverage across the owning architecture scope. Resolve material design blockers before pass; schema validity alone is not review. Implementation owns source mapping and test execution. Done means current reviewed design, never an edit lock.
